Phase 60 implementation. Branch `phase/roadmap-parser-decimals-deployed-no-silent-drops`, commit 3f23845.

tagteam/roadmap.py
1. `_SUFFIX = r"((?:\.\d+)|[A-Za-z])?"` — one module-level fragment now composed by all
   four phase-number patterns (_PHASE_HEADING_RE, _PHASE_HEADING_LENIENT_RE,
   _PHASE_NUM_REF_RE, _PHASE_NUM_SLUG_REF_RE). Phase 59 widened those same four
   independently, which is how the dotted case got missed; one fragment is what stops
   the next widening reaching three of four. Written as two non-empty alternatives
   under one `?` rather than `(?:\.\d+)?|[A-Za-z]?` — the latter matches empty on its
   first branch and only reaches the letter by backtracking. The group is optional, so
   the three call sites read `(m.group(2) or "")`.
2. `deployed` added to _TERMINAL_STATUS_WORDS.
3. New `unparsed_phase_headings(text) -> [(line_no, line)]` + _PHASE_HEADING_SUSPECT_RE
   (`^###[ \t]+Phase\b`), printed by `roadmap check` as `warn:` lines.

Your four round-1 notes, each addressed:
- `roadmap phases`, not `roadmap list` — corrected in success criterion 1 of the plan doc.
- Warnings emit before graph validation can error. The print sits above the
  `graph_problems` try block, so unsupported headings show when every heading is
  unsupported (ValueError "No phases found") and when an unrelated graph error exists.
  Exit codes unchanged: 1 in both those cases, 0 on `roadmap ok`. Two tests pin exactly
  this (test_warning_shows_when_every_heading_is_unsupported,
  test_warning_shows_alongside_an_unrelated_graph_error).
- Focused tests cover the cases you named: decimal state-format reference
  (phase-9.1-decimal-child), repeated decimal identity (duplicate phase number 9.1),
  unsupported 9.1.2 / 9-1 / roman headings, and warning line numbers.
- The narrow guarantee is written into the docstring verbatim: suspect lines missed by
  the *lenient* pattern, not a general strict/lenient discrepancy check. A bare
  `### Phase 5b:` is not a warning (lenient understands it; validate_identities already
  reports the empty name) — pinned by test_bare_heading_without_a_name_is_not_a_warning.

tests/test_roadmap.py — 3 new classes, 21 tests (TestDecimalPhaseNumbers,
TestDeployedIsTerminal, TestUnparsedHeadingWarnings), including an explicit
test_letter_suffixes_are_unchanged over the Phase 59 fixture.

VERIFICATION — one correction to the plan you should see.
The plan promised a real-world check against Liminal. I ran it and it is INCONCLUSIVE:
`~/projects/journaling/Liminal/docs/roadmap.md` now parses 29/29 headings with no
unparsed headings and no non-terminal statuses — on the PRE-fix parser (checked out from
main into a scratch tree) and the post-fix parser alike. The roadmap has been edited
since the 2026-09-15 finding; the decimal headings appear to have been renamed as a
workaround, so it no longer reproduces. Liminal does NOT evidence this fix. The
evidence is the recorded repro and the new tests. Plan doc's Verification section has
been rewritten to say this rather than leave the original claim standing.

What does evidence it:
- Repro, same script, before -> after: strict/lenient headings both go from
  ['Phase 9', 'Phase 10a'] to ['Phase 9', 'Phase 9.1', 'Phase 10a'];
  dep ref 'Phase 9.1' resolves False -> True;
  is_terminal_status('Deployed to prod') False -> True.
- This repo end to end: `roadmap check` -> `roadmap ok: 61 phase(s), 18 dependency
  edge(s)` with no warn lines. Appending `### Phase IX: Roman numerals` ->
  `warn: unparsed phase heading (line 550): ### Phase IX: Roman numerals` plus the same
  `roadmap ok` line, exit 0, and `roadmap ready` still lists normally. Roadmap restored.

Full suite: not run by me — gatekeeper is on_submit, so this call's run is the one on
the record. Focused: tests/test_roadmap.py 102 passed.

No CHANGELOG.md exists in this repo, so the release-note behavior change (projects with
decimal phases will see those phases appear in ready/queue for the first time) is
recorded in the plan doc Files section and the roadmap entry, to go in the GitHub
release body whenever this ships.

GATE: PASS | scope 2 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2030 passed, 5 skipped, 5m56s)
checked: HEAD 3f23845

Approved at 3f23845. Reviewed the implementation diff, updated phase document, and regression tests against the approved plan. The shared suffix fragment is consistently applied to all four regexes; all optional suffix consumers normalize None safely, preserving bare and letter identities. Decimal dependencies resolve without changing queue ordering. Deployed uses the shared terminal predicate. Unsupported-heading warnings remain separate from graph problems and print before validation failures, preserving existing exit codes. The plan-review notes are addressed.

Verification: gate reports 2030 passed, 5 skipped at HEAD 3f23845; accepted without rerunning the full suite. Reviewer focused run: tests/test_roadmap.py, 102 passed in 0.46s. git diff --check passed. No blocking findings.

The Liminal check is correctly documented as inconclusive; approval relies on the reproducible regression cases and implementation review, not that live roadmap. Preserve the recorded behavior-change note in the release body when shipping: decimal phases previously omitted can now enter ready/queue.
